init.title: LG NetCast HDCP options
init.description: Choose what you want to configure.

power_on.title: Power-on behavior
power_on.description: Choose how Home Assistant should power on the TV.

data_description.turn_on_method: Choose how Home Assistant should power on the TV. Leave it as none to hide the turn-on button. Wake-on-LAN is not supported by every 2011 model.
data_description.wol_mac: Ethernet MAC address of the TV.
data_description.wol_broadcast: IPv4 broadcast address for the magic packet.
data_description.turn_on_action: Action to run for IR, CEC, or another power-on method. An IR integration must already be configured.

sources.title: Input sources
sources.description: Map custom source names to key sequences and choose the input to select before standby.

data_description.input_sources: Optional mapping of custom source names to key sequences. HDMI1-HDMI4 and AV1 are available automatically. Use this for other inputs, custom names, or IR tracking sequences.
data_description.power_off_source: Optional direct input or custom source to select before entering standby. Choose none to disable. Set this to HDMI1 when an HDMI-CEC device can only wake the TV if its input was active.

tracking.title: State tracking
tracking.description: Configure the optional external IR receiver integration.

data_description.ir_state_tracking: Enable after configuring an external IR receiver to call the lg_netcast_hdcp.process_ir_key action. This improves input and mute tracking and removes the state limitation warning.

process_ir_key.name: Process IR key

confirm.title: Enable IR receiver state tracking
confirm.description:
The integration is not fully tracking {name}. It can query power, the current channel, and the TV UI mode, but it cannot read the active HDMI input or volume. Without an external IR receiver, input changes made with the TV remote are not tracked. If you use HDMI-CEC (for example an Apple TV), turning the TV off on another input with the TV remote may prevent the CEC device from waking it again.

Set **Source before power off** to the CEC input, or configure an IR receiver and enable **IR receiver state tracking**.

Only continue if you have configured an external IR receiver to call **lg_netcast_hdcp.process_ir_key**. If you do not have an IR receiver, cancel and dismiss the issue instead.
